**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 12.4, p0045).**

- **Issue:** § 12.4 imposes a one-sided, 24-month **no-hire** on Customer covering *any* Vendor employee, expressly with no general-advertising or unsolicited-applicant carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). This fails our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) and sits at the walk-away boundary (no-hire, all personnel, 24 months).
- **Additional leverage:** § 12.3 (p0044) has Vendor acknowledging that Customer has made **no no-hire commitment** and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment — the two clauses are internally inconsistent.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** delete § 12.4, with the fallback (mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel involved in the Services, advertising/unsolicited carve-outs, no no-hire) offered in the comment.
